Vietnam · 9–16 Nov · 7 nights · mid-range

Tunnels, peaks, karts and canyons

You clear Saigon airport at 11:00 on Monday and fly out of Saigon at 08:00 the next Monday. Củ Chi and go-karts in Saigon, then north by plane and night train for three days in Sapa: Fansipan, the glass bridge, canyoning, the alpine coaster, a Red Dao herbal bath and two nights on Cầu Mây street. Then a full shopping day in Hà Nội and a last Saigon weekend. Two flights, both checked on Google Flights.

    Know before you go

    Weather in mid-November

    PlaceFeels like
    SaigonHot, 27–32°C. Dry season is starting.
    Hà NộiMild and dry, low to mid 20s°C. The best month of the year.
    SapaCool days, cold nights. The Fansipan summit can be near freezing.

    Pack a proper warm layer for Sapa, plus dry clothes for after canyoning. You can buy cheap jackets in Sapa town.

    What changed and why

    • Đà Lạt dropped: its two days went to Sapa. Sapa now gets Fansipan, the glass bridge and zipline, canyoning, the alpine coaster, a herbal bath and two nights out.
    • One flight fewer: Saigon → Hà Nội ($48) replaces the two Đà Lạt flights ($31 + $56). Flights fall from ~$123 to ~$84 per person, and two hotel nights go too.
    • Sapa nightlife is small: a handful of bars on Cầu Mây street, busiest at weekends. Your Sapa nights are Wednesday and Thursday, so expect a fun small-town bar crawl, not clubs.
    • Saturday flight back: Sunday Hà Nội → Saigon flights cost $76–94. Saturday's are $36–48.
    • Still dropped: basket boat (central Vietnam, flood season) and Ninh Bình.

    Getting around

    • Install Grab. It works in Saigon, Hà Nội and Sapa town; book Sapa day trips through your hotel or a local driver.
    • Travel light for the night trains. Your Hà Nội hotel can hold big bags from Tuesday evening to Saturday.
    • Budget fares usually don't include checked bags, so add one before you compare. You'll be flying home heavier after Hà Nội.
    • Saigon domestic flights leave from T1 or the new T3 depending on airline. Check each ticket.

    Paperwork

    • Most passports, Indian included, need an e-visa. Apply only on the government portal, evisa.gov.vn, at least a week ahead.
    • Buy travel insurance that names canyoning and ziplining.

    Train Street: the authorities ban tours from bringing people onto the tracks. Sit inside a café when a train comes and never stand on the rails.
